questions.text:
Human behaviour:

  • Homophily = humans tend to flock
  • We look for people like us

Danger of bubbles:

  • Internet tools give us exactly what we want
  • Danger = ↓ cognitive diversity
  • Social search = filtered results
  • Same people / ideas over and over

Structural holes / good ideas:

  • Ronald Burt - VP at Raytheon
  • Asked all employees for ideas (survey)
  • Best ideas from people who bridged / connected social networks
  • eg offices in different areas of country
  • Creativity = import / export?
  • Bring ideas from one place into a new context
